script_text: Something dramatic shifts in your love life this week, Leo — and it starts before Wednesday. From Monday through Wednesday, Venus in your 5th House forms a tense square to Saturn in your 7th House of partnerships, creating friction in romantic situations where you feel someone isn't meeting your standards. Tuesday is particularly challenging when Mercury squares Pluto in your 8th House, bringing power struggles around shared resources or hidden emotions. But Wednesday flips everything: the Sun trines Jupiter in your 9th House of expansion, illuminating a powerful opportunity — perhaps through travel, publishing, or higher education — that could transform your entire year. Thursday through Sunday, Venus finally slips into harmonious sextile with Uranus in your 3rd House of communication, bringing exciting, unexpected connections through conversations or local travel. Your best day is Wednesday because the Sun-Jupiter trine activates your 9th House of adventure and gives you leverage. Your worst day is Tuesday due to the Mercury-Pluto square breeding suspicion. This week, stop chasing validation from people who drain you — your fire element energy deserves partners who fan your flames, not dim them. Follow for daily updates.
